title: Concordia University
description: Concordia University's official web colour palette defines the primary colours Burgundy (#912338), Magenta (#DB0272), Orange (#DA3A16), Mauve (#573996), Dark Blue (#004085), Blue (#0072A8), Turquoise (#057D78) and Green (#508212), and the secondary colours Yellow (#E5A712), Gold (#CBB576), Cyan (#00ADEF) and Lime (#8CC63E).
